description: This Kotlin source file 'MainActivity.kt' implements the main activity for an Android feedback collection application. It manages UI components such as input fields, a list view for feedback entries, and the logic for persisting feedback data using SharedPreferences with custom JSON encoding/decoding. It defines classes for the activity, feedback items, a JSON codec, and a list adapter for rendering feedback entries with styling cues.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing feedback form UI and storage.

classes.name: FeedbackItem
classes.description: Data class representing individual feedback entries.

classes.name: FeedbackStorageCodec
classes.description: Utility object handling custom JSON serialization and deserialization of feedback list.

classes.name: FeedbackAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for rendering feedback items in a ListView with stylings.

methods.name: loadFeedback
